text: Society Actuaries provides extensive online database called Mortality Rate Tables (MORT) https://mort.soa.org/. database contains mortality, lapse, valuation tables cover variety product types countries. Users database can download tables Excel, CSV, XML formats. package provides convenience functions read XML formats database return R objects.

title: Read data from mort.soa.org and return a list of data frames — read_mort_soa
text: function first checks provided table_id available mort.soa.org. found, error returned. match found, list containing tables underneath table_id returned. list contains several attributes can queried using attr({list}, "{attribute}). Available attributes include: name - Name table table_id description - detailed description table usage - Intended usage layout - Table layout nation - Nation origin sub_descriptions - character vector containing detailed descriptions sub-table underneath table_id tables either "Aggregate" "Select Ultimate" structure. Aggregate structures contains single table one dimension (usually Age). Select Ultimate structures contain two tables. first table contains two dimensions Age Duration. second table contains single dimension Age. convenience, two-dimensional tables pivotted longer "tidy" format 3 columns: Age, Duration, mortality () rate.
